packaging.isolated_installed_wheel_tui_smoke: passed: real command missing-middle readback, unchanged draft/history, private resume with no replay, fresh clear approval

ci.reason: Private persistent output storage, native leases, command capture and frontend resume integration require both native runners

limitations: Unknown credentials and personal data are not automatically guaranteed absent; retained logs are private plaintext
Expiry prevents readback; physical pruning waits for an explicitly approved save or clear
A lost unsaved owner namespace cannot be recovered by guessing opaque log IDs
Concurrent storage changes can prevent retention; commands are never rerun automatically
Atomic replace/sync failure can leave an uncertain persisted result; inspect local logs
Cancellation does not commit the current partial capture; old retained logs remain
No background jobs, interactive stdin, arbitrary-path artifact reads or binary uploads
No full Python/client/macOS CI matrix in this batch; WSL is local POSIX coverage
Fixed model replies establish workflow behavior, not coding success rate or agent parity
